evidence_rules.raw_log_hash_meaning: SHA-256 of the exact complete decoded log string re-encoded as UTF-8, including BOM, CR/LF and terminal newlines; not a ZIP or HTTP-transfer checksum.
evidence_rules.excerpt_hash_meaning: SHA-256 of exact raw excerpt UTF-8 bytes. Line numbers are one-based within that decoded log. Excerpts retain original timestamps, ANSI escapes and line endings.
evidence_rules.metadata_hash_meaning: SHA-256 of the full returned UTF-8 API JSON response; selected metadata below are parsed fields. The raw full metadata response is not embedded.
evidence_rules.reported_report_hash_meaning: Hashes printed by CI are retained as reported receipts; this collection did not download or independently recompute their artifact bodies.
evidence_rules.same_tree_boundary: The observed PR merge commit has the published head as a parent and exactly the same Git tree. Each read test job prints that merge checkout; aggregate-only jobs have no claimed checkout.
evidence_rules.integrity_is_not_quality: Passing oracle controls and report integrity do not replace a failing current quality verdict.

p16.claim_boundary: Current in-process public delivery plus MCP serialization; installed stdio is proved only by its separate harness.
